messages.text:
"An open world Rpg where choices affect the story. In a age or style similar to Skyrim with a character creator with amazing detail and specifications made for everyone. The races you can choose from go from humans, to elves, to beastkin, to orcs, moth girls, lizard people. Able to become a werewolf, or vampire. Able to wield swords and weapons of all kinds. And able to build sexual relationships with others. Able to choose gender, with can include a both genders at the same time option. Moth girls also are covered in different types of fur depending on type of moth, lust moths being the strongest and rarest, and moth girls are usually hunted for breeding fodder or their fur pelts. Moth girls have four arms, white fur all over leaving no skin, a pair of wings, a abdomen like tail for reproduction and a spinneret, with antenna instead of ears and giant fluff collars on their necks (which is usually found on white or pink moths only.)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
